events.what_it_is: An immersive Good Girl fragrance pop-up celebrating the scent's 10th anniversary, with fragrance discovery, interactive challenges, prizes, beauty experiences and a Good Girl Café.
events.what_is_free: Admission is free. Interactive activities can yield prizes such as miniatures and makeup services; Carolina Herrera x Myka frozen yogurt is advertised for the first 100 guests.
events.caveats: Free timed reservations are available, but current event information explicitly says walk-ins are allowed based on capacity. Treat this as first-come access with optional RSVP rather than guaranteed admission. Promotional prizes and frozen yogurt are limited.
events.practical_notes: Friday September 11: noon–6 PM; Saturday September 12: 11 AM–6 PM; Sunday September 13: 11 AM–3 PM. Approximate session duration is 40 minutes.

events.event_name: White House Black Market NYFW Pop-Up
events.address: Saint Coffee, 201 7th Ave, New York, NY 10011
events.what_it_is: A one-morning NYFW stop at Saint Coffee previewing White House Black Market's fall collection.
events.what_is_free: Current event information advertises complimentary coffee, black-and-white cookies and a signature WHBM shirt to take home.
events.caveats: The event is described as open to the public with no RSVP or approval requirement published. Complimentary items are promotional inventory and can run out.
events.practical_notes: Friday, September 11 from 8 AM–1 PM at Saint Coffee, 201 Seventh Avenue.

events.what_it_is: A NYFW recharge-and-content pop-up centered on Calzedonia legwear, with beauty refreshes, a photo booth, customization and coffee.
events.what_is_free: Public entry, coffee, branded stickers, hair refreshes and the photo booth are advertised as free. Some sources also mention skincare sampling. Embroidery is tied to purchase of the 20 Denier Hosiery Knee Highs.
events.caveats: Current sources describe the event as open to the public and do not publish an RSVP or approval requirement. Free embroidery requires purchase of the qualifying knee highs; other complimentary items are subject to availability.
events.practical_notes: Saturday September 12 and Sunday September 13, noon–5 PM daily at 188 Lafayette Street.

events.address: Madison Square Park, Fifth Ave & Broadway at 23rd St, New York, NY 10010
events.what_it_is: IBM's free US Open Championship Weekend fan hub with AI-powered tennis activations, live match viewing, a serve simulator, AI-enabled ping pong and an AI photo booth.
events.what_is_free: IBM explicitly describes the four-day fan experience as free and open to the public. Activations and live viewing are included; official merchandise is available separately.
events.caveats: No RSVP or approval requirement is published. The activation is outdoors in Madison Square Park, and programming can follow tournament scheduling.
events.practical_notes: Friday September 11: 9 AM–9 PM; Saturday September 12: 11 AM–8 PM; Sunday September 13: 11 AM–7 PM. Located at the southeast corner of Madison Square Park near One Madison Avenue.
